questions.q: Where in Setup can you confirm which edition your org is running, per this lesson?
options: The Company Information page, under Organization Edition
The Object Manager page only
There is no way to check an org's edition
The Reports tab
questions.explain: The Company Information page's Organization Edition field shows exactly which edition an org is running, including Developer Edition for a Trailhead Playground.

questions.q: What does this lesson say a Trailhead Playground is actually built on?
options: A real, standing Developer Edition license, not a trial
A 30-day trial org that always expires
A read-only sandbox copy
A paid Enterprise Edition org
questions.explain: A Trailhead Playground's underlying Organization Edition is Developer Edition, a genuine permanent license tier, not a countdown trial.

questions.q: What two limits does this lesson say cap a Developer Edition org?
options: Two paid user licenses and about 10MB of data storage
Unlimited users but zero data storage
One year of use and then permanent deletion
No Setup access at all
questions.explain: Developer Edition is capped to two paid user licenses and roughly 10MB of data storage — enough for practice, not for running a real company.

questions.q: How does this lesson say you log into your Trailhead Playground's underlying Developer Edition org?
options: With a real username and password, automatically created and managed by Trailhead
You cannot log in directly; it's only accessible from inside Trailhead challenges
With a shared username used by every Trailhead user
Through a temporary guest link that expires in one hour
questions.explain: A Developer Edition org has a real username and password just like any other Salesforce org, which Trailhead creates and manages for you.

questions.q: What does this lesson say a Developer Edition org supports, beyond standard admin features like Setup and Flow?
options: Installing real, free AppExchange packages, just like a production org
Nothing beyond the basic Home tab
Only read-only access to standard objects
Live customer transactions
questions.explain: Because it's a full org, a Developer Edition org fully supports installing real AppExchange packages, the same way a production org would.
